# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-config-reference.ts (npm run docs:config) from schema/fusion-sim.schema.json and
     schema/scenario.schema.json. Do not edit: change the schema source and regenerate. -->

Every field of a reactor configuration (the argument of `new Simulation(cfg)`, the `*.reactor.json` file of
`fusion-sim run`) and of a scenario (`--scenario FILE`), with its type, unit, default, allowed values and
description. The tables are generated from the JSON Schemas, so they list exactly what the validator accepts;
unknown properties are rejected.

**How to read the tables.** *Unit* is the unit of the stored value (`—`: dimensionless or not applicable).
*Default* is the value the model uses when the field is absent, as the schema declares it; `—` means the schema
declares none (the field is required, or its default depends on other fields and is stated in the description).
*Allowed values / range* uses interval notation: `(0, 100]` excludes 0 and includes 100; `≥ 0` is a lower bound only.
Fields marked **Opt-in module** are switches that turn on a model beyond the base behaviour (the modules of the
1.5D profile model added in v4, and the 1.5D model itself): their default reproduces the earlier behaviour, so a
configuration that does not name them is unchanged.

Companion files: [schema/fusion-sim.schema.json](../schema/fusion-sim.schema.json) and [schema/scenario.schema.json](../schema/scenario.schema.json)
(machine-readable, for editors and validators).

## Opt-in modules of the 1.5D profile model

The modules of the 1.5D profile model that v4 added are opt-in: each switch has a default that reproduces the previous
behaviour ("off") and one or more values that switch the module on. They need `fidelity` `"1.5D"` (tokamak and
spherical tokamak; the default `"0D"` is the global power balance), and the settings of a module are only used while
it is on. The first row, `fidelity`, is the older switch of the 1.5D model itself.

| Module | Switch | Default (off) | Opt-in values | Settings used only when on | What it changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.5D profile model | `fidelity` | `"0D"` | `"1.5D"` | — | Radial transport with a Grad-Shafranov equilibrium instead of the global power balance. Every module below needs it. |
| Predictive transport | `profiles.transportModel` | `"scaling"` | `"cgm"`, `"bgb"`, `"ifspppl"` | — | Critical-gradient, Bohm/gyro-Bohm or IFS-PPPL closure instead of the tau_E-constrained transport. |
| EPED1-type pedestal | `profiles.pedestalModel` | `"fixed"` | `"eped1"` | `pedPbGradient`, `pedKbmCoefficient`, `pedDensityExponent` | Pedestal width and height from the KBM and peeling-ballooning constraints. |
| ELM energy loss | `profiles.elmLoss` | `"fixed"` | `"loarte"` | — | Energy removed by an ELM from the pedestal collisionality (Loarte et al.) instead of a fixed fraction. |
| Impurity and helium-ash transport | `profiles.impurityTransport` | `"legacy"` | `"anomalous"`, `"facit"` | `impurityDoverDe`, `impurityPinchOverPe`, `impurityExtraSpecies`, `impurityExtraConcentration` | Profile-resolved impurities and helium ash (anomalous or FACIT) instead of scalar inventories. |
| Fast-ion model | `profiles.fastIonModel` | `"scalar"` | `"profile"` | `fastOrbitScale` | Fast-ion energy profiles with slowing-down delay and orbit smoothing instead of two scalar pools. |
| Current-drive model | `profiles.cdModel` | `"legacy"` | `"physics"` | `eccd` | NBCD from the fast-ion current and ECCD from a launcher model instead of the efficiency factors. |
| Sawtooth trigger | `profiles.sawtoothTrigger` | `"shear"` | `"porcelli"` | — | The Porcelli-Boucher-Rosenbluth conditions instead of the critical shear at q = 1. |
| Sawtooth reconnection | `profiles.sawtoothReconnection` | `"legacy"` | `"kadomtsev"` | — | Kadomtsev's full reconnection with a poloidal-flux reset instead of the flattening only. |
| Neoclassical coefficients | `profiles.neoclassicalModel` | `"sauter"` | `"redl"` | — | Redl et al. bootstrap and conductivity coefficients instead of Sauter et al. (an alternative, not an addition). |
| Edge model for the separatrix temperature | `profiles.edgeModel` | `"legacy"` | `"twoPoint"` | — | Two-point T_sep from the edge model (Eich lambda_q, divertor spreading) instead of the conduction-limited estimate. |

## Magnetic confinement

Used when `method` is `tokamak`, `spherical_tokamak`, `stellarator`.

Magnetic confinement: tokamak, spherical tokamak, stellarator. Rule tokamak-needs-plasma-current: Ip_MA must be above 0 unless the method is stellarator.

### Top-level fields

Rules the JSON Schema cannot express (the runtime validator enforces them):

- `tokamak-needs-plasma-current`: Ip_MA must be above 0 unless the method is stellarator.

| `method` | string, required | — | — | `"tokamak"`, `"spherical_tokamak"`, `"stellarator"` | Confinement method. |
| `geometry` | object, required | — | — | — | Plasma shape (D-shaped Miller-type cross section). Rule minor-radius-below-major-radius: geometry.a must be smaller than geometry.R (aspect ratio R/a above 1). |
| `B0` | number, required | T | — | (0, 100] | Toroidal field on axis. |
| `Ip_MA` | number, required | MA | — | [0, 200] | Plasma current (0 for a stellarator: bootstrap current neglected). |
| `fuel` | string, required | — | — | `"DT"`, `"DD"`, `"DHe3"`, `"pB11"` | Fuel cycle: D-T, D-D, D-3He or p-11B. |
| `fuelFracA` | number, required | — | — | [0, 1] | Fraction of the first species (D-T: n_D / (n_D + n_T)). |
| `n_target` | number, required | m^-3 | — | (0, 1e23] | Target volume-averaged electron density. |
| `n_rampTime` | number, required | s | — | [0, 100000] | Density ramp time. |
| `heating` | object, required | — | — | — | Auxiliary heating. |

| `impurity` | object, required | — | — | — | Impurities. |

| `H89` | number, required | — | — | (0, 10] | L-mode confinement factor relative to the ITER89-P scaling. |
| `scaling` | string, required | — | — | `"IPB98y2"`, `"ITPA20"`, `"ITPA20-IL"`, `"ST_Valovic"` | Confinement scaling law of the H-mode: 'IPB98y2' (default), 'ITPA20' or 'ITPA20-IL' (Verdoolaege et al. 2021, areal elongation and average LCFS triangularity), 'ST_Valovic' (spherical tokamak); H98 multiplies the selected scaling. |
| `stellarator` | object, required | — | — | — | Stellarator settings (used with method "stellarator"). |

| `fidelity` | string | — | `"0D"` | `"0D"`, `"1.5D"` | **Opt-in module: 1.5D profile model.** Default `"0D"` (off). '0D': global power balance; '1.5D': radial profile transport with a Grad-Shafranov equilibrium (tokamak and spherical tokamak only, ignored for a stellarator). |

#### `geometry`

Plasma shape (D-shaped Miller-type cross section). Rule minor-radius-below-major-radius: geometry.a must be smaller than geometry.R (aspect ratio R/a above 1).

Rules the JSON Schema cannot express (the runtime validator enforces them):

- `minor-radius-below-major-radius`: geometry.a must be smaller than geometry.R (aspect ratio R/a above 1).

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `geometry.R` | number, required | m | — | (0, 100] | Major radius. |
| `geometry.a` | number, required | m | — | (0, 50] | Minor radius. |
| `geometry.kappa` | number, required | — | — | [1, 5] | Elongation of the 95 % flux surface (of the LCFS if profiles.lcfsKappa is not given). |
| `geometry.delta` | number, required | — | — | [-1, 1] | Triangularity of the 95 % flux surface. |

#### `profiles`: 1.5D profile settings

1.5D profile-model settings (only used with fidelity "1.5D"); every property overrides the model default.

##### Numerics

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.nRho` | integer | — | `50` | [8, 2000] | Radial cells on rho_tor. |
| `profiles.gridPacking` | number | — | `4` | [0, 100] | Edge packing of the radial cells (tanh step in the cell density): the cells at the pedestal and the separatrix are (1 + gridPacking) times narrower than the core cells, for the same nRho. 0 is the uniform grid of v3. |
| `profiles.rtol` | number | — | `0.01` | (0, 1] | Relative tolerance of the error control of the transport time step (TR-BDF2). The model replaces a value outside its domain by the default at run time. |
| `profiles.atol` | number | — | `0.0001` | [0, 1] | Absolute tolerance of the error control of the transport time step, as a fraction of the profile maximum (0: a purely relative tolerance). |
| `profiles.dtMax` | number | s | `0.5` | [0.000001, 100000] | Longest transport time step. |
| `profiles.nonlinearSolver` | string | — | `"auto"` | `"auto"`, `"picard"`, `"newton"`, `"pc"` | Solver of the nonlinear system of a transport stage. 'auto': Newton-Raphson for a predictive transport model ('cgm'), the Pereverzev-Corrigan Picard iteration for the closures that ask for it ('bgb', 'ifspppl': Newton costs more than it buys there), Picard iteration with Anderson mixing for 'scaling'; 'picard', 'newton' (with the Pereverzev-Corrigan Picard iteration as its fallback) and 'pc' (that stabilised Picard iteration alone) force one. |

##### Equilibrium and plasma shape

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.eqNR` | integer | — | `49` | [9, 1025] | Grad-Shafranov grid nodes in R. |
| `profiles.eqUpdateInterval` | number | s | `10` | (0, 100000] | Upper limit of the interval between equilibrium updates. |
| `profiles.lcfsKappa` | number | — | — | [1, 5] | Elongation of the last closed flux surface; the elongation of `geometry` (a 95 % value) if absent. |
| `profiles.lcfsDelta` | number | — | — | [-1, 1] | Triangularity of the last closed flux surface; the triangularity of `geometry` if absent. |
| `profiles.lcfsRef95` | object | — | — | — | The 95 % surface shape (kappa95, delta95) that lcfsKappa and lcfsDelta belong to. The 0D volume, surface and cross-section then follow an edited `geometry.kappa` or `geometry.delta` in the ratio kappa/kappa95 and delta/delta95 (the ITER and DEMO presets); without it the LCFS values are absolute. |
| `profiles.IpWaveform` | array of [number, number] | — | — | elements [0, 1e7] s, (0, 200] MA; 1 to 10000 items | Plasma-current programme I_p(t): the boundary condition of the current diffusion as points [t (s), I_p (MA)] in increasing time, linearly interpolated and held constant beyond the first and last point. Ip_MA is what the initial equilibrium is solved for and should equal the programme at t = 0. Absent: I_p constant (and a live control). Points [s, MA], the first number strictly increasing. |

##### Transport

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.transportModel` | string | — | `"scaling"` | `"scaling"`, `"cgm"`, `"bgb"`, `"ifspppl"` | **Opt-in module: Predictive transport.** Default `"scaling"` (off). 'scaling': transport constrained by the tau_E scaling law (validated global dynamics); 'cgm': critical-gradient model (predictive, uncalibrated); 'bgb': mixed Bohm/gyro-Bohm model of Erba et al. (predictive, JET-validated coefficients; the Bohm term is non-local in the edge temperature); 'ifspppl': IFS-PPPL ITG critical gradient and stiffness of Kotschenreuther et al. 1995 (predictive). Every model but 'scaling' is predictive: tau_E and H98 emerge (the diagnostics H98y2 and HITPA20). |
| `profiles.chiShape` | number | — | `3` | [0, 100] | Shape of chi, proportional to 1 + chiShape rho^2. |
| `profiles.stiffness` | number | — | `2` | [0, 100] | Profile stiffness: chi is multiplied by 1 + stiffness max(0, (R/L_T)/critGrad - 1). |
| `profiles.critGrad` | number | — | `5` | (0, 100] | Critical normalised temperature gradient R/L_T (ITG/TEM). |
| `profiles.chiRatio` | number | — | `1` | (0, 100] | chi_i / chi_e. |
| `profiles.DoverChi` | number | — | `0.3` | (0, 100] | Particle diffusivity over chi_e. |

##### Pedestal and ELMs

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.pedestalModel` | string | — | `"fixed"` | `"fixed"`, `"eped1"` | **Opt-in module: EPED1-type pedestal.** Default `"fixed"` (off). Pedestal of the 1.5D model. 'fixed': the width pedestalWidth, the barrier depth etbFactor and the ballooning limit alphaCritFactor. 'eped1': an EPED1-type pedestal (Snyder et al. 2009): the width follows the KBM constraint Delta = 0.076 sqrt(beta_p,ped), the height is limited by the peeling-ballooning constraint (anchored to the DIII-D ITER-demonstration discharges), the barrier depth adapts (in H-mode, up to 16 times deeper than etbFactor) to hold the pedestal-top pressure at that limit and an ELM fires when it is exceeded; pedestalWidth is then only the width before the first evaluation, etbFactor the barrier depth at the limit, and the radial grid is packed for the EPED width. |
| `profiles.pedestalWidth` | number | rho_tor | `0.06` | (0, 0.5) | Pedestal width. |
| `profiles.etbFactor` | number | — | `0.08` | (0, 1] | Edge transport barrier: chi_ETB / chi_turb at the pedestal. |
| `profiles.alphaCritFactor` | number | — | `1` | (0, 10] | ELM trigger threshold as a multiple of the critical ballooning alpha. |
| `profiles.pedPbGradient` | number | — | `6.214293615795698` | (0, 100] | *Used only while `profiles.pedestalModel` is on.* Peeling-ballooning pressure gradient d(beta_p)/d(psi_N) of the 'eped1' pedestal (dimensionless): with the KBM width it sets beta_p,ped = (0.076 C)^2 and the width 0.076^2 C. Default 6.2: the DIII-D fit of the maximum pressure gradient before an ELM, 103 (I_p B_T)^0.94 kPa per psi_N (Groebner et al., GA-A26243), at I_p B_T = 3.2 MA T. |
| `profiles.pedKbmCoefficient` | number | — | `0.076` | (0, 10] | *Used only while `profiles.pedestalModel` is on.* Coefficient of the KBM width of the 'eped1' pedestal, Delta = c sqrt(beta_p,ped) in psi_N (0.076: Snyder et al. 2009 and Groebner et al., GA-A26243; EPED1.6 calculates the coefficient). |
| `profiles.pedDensityExponent` | number | — | `0.34` | [0, 5] | *Used only while `profiles.pedestalModel` is on.* Exponent of the pedestal density over the Greenwald density (relative to 0.5) in the pedestal poloidal beta of the 'eped1' pedestal: 0.34 is the exponent of the EPED prediction for the ITER baseline (Snyder 2015, H-mode branch, least-squares power law over n_ped Z_eff^0.5 = 4 to 15.6e19 m^-3). 0: the height does not depend on the density. |
| `profiles.elmLoss` | string | — | `"fixed"` | `"fixed"`, `"loarte"` | **Opt-in module: ELM energy loss.** Default `"fixed"` (off). Energy an ELM removes. 'fixed': elmFraction of the pedestal region times U(0.8, 1.2). 'loarte': the fraction f(nu*_ped) of W_ped = 3/2 n_ped (T_e,ped + T_i,ped) V that Loarte et al. (2003) correlate with the pedestal collisionality, times U(0.8, 1.2), with the depth and the region of the crash that carry that energy. |
| `profiles.elmFraction` | number | — | `0.35` | (0, 1) | ELM crash depth, Delta W / W_ped. |

##### Impurities and helium ash

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.impurityTransport` | string | — | `"legacy"` | `"legacy"`, `"anomalous"`, `"facit"` | **Opt-in module: Impurity and helium-ash transport.** Default `"legacy"` (off). Impurities and helium ash of the 1.5D model. 'legacy': the scalar inventories (one He-ash content with tau_He* = (tau_He* over tau_E) tau_E, one uniform impurity concentration). 'anomalous': n_He(rho) and the impurity densities are evolved on the particle-transport solver with the electron D and v scaled by impurityDoverDe and impurityPinchOverPe, the He ash sourced by the local fusion rate, the impurities fixed to their concentration at the separatrix (tungsten with a wall source). 'facit': the same with the neoclassical D, K, H of FACIT (Fajardo et al. 2022) added. |
| `profiles.impuritySetpoint` | string | — | `"average"` | `"average"`, `"separatrix"` | Meaning of the configured impurity concentrations in the profile-resolved modes. 'average': the volume-average concentration N_z/N_e (a slow controller sets the separatrix value that gives it); 'separatrix': the concentration at the separatrix (a fixed boundary value). |
| `profiles.impurityDoverDe` | number | — | `1` | [0, 1000] | *Used only while `profiles.impurityTransport` is on.* Anomalous impurity diffusivity over the electron particle diffusivity (impurityTransport other than legacy). Zero disables anomalous particle flux, including its pinch, in 'anomalous' mode. |
| `profiles.impurityPinchOverPe` | number | — | `1` | [0, 1000] | *Used only while `profiles.impurityTransport` is on.* Anomalous impurity convection over the electron convection, the turbulent pinch (impurityTransport other than legacy). |
| `profiles.impurityExtraSpecies` | string | — | — | `"Be"`, `"C"`, `"Ne"`, `"Ar"`, `"W"` | *Used only while `profiles.impurityTransport` is on.* Third impurity species of the profile-resolved module, besides impurity.species and impurity.seedSpecies. |
| `profiles.impurityExtraConcentration` | number | — | — | [0, 1] | *Used only while `profiles.impurityTransport` is on.* Concentration n_Z/n_e of the third species at the separatrix. |

##### Fast ions and current drive

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.fastIonModel` | string | — | `"scalar"` | `"scalar"`, `"profile"` | **Opt-in module: Fast-ion model.** Default `"scalar"` (off). Fast ions (NBI ions, charged fusion products) of the 1.5D model. 'scalar': two scalar energy pools for the fast-ion pressure of beta, instantaneous local heating. 'profile': energy fields on the radial grid with the slowing-down delay of the heating and an orbit-width smoothing of the source; the fast pressure enters beta, the Grad-Shafranov pressure table and the ballooning drive (not the bootstrap current). |
| `profiles.fastOrbitScale` | number | — | `1` | [0, 10] | *Used only while `profiles.fastIonModel` is on.* Multiplier of the rms orbit width of the fast ions in the 'profile' fast-ion model (0: no orbit smoothing). |
| `profiles.cdModel` | string | — | `"legacy"` | `"legacy"`, `"physics"` | **Opt-in module: Current-drive model.** Default `"legacy"` (off). Current drive of the 1.5D model. 'legacy': I_CD = gamma P / (n R0) with the efficiency factors nbcdEff and eccdEff. 'physics': neutral-beam current drive from the fast-ion current of the slowing-down distribution with the shielding and trapped-electron correction of Start and Cordey (1980), electron-cyclotron current drive from the launcher `eccd` with the efficiency of Lin-Liu, Chan and Prater (2003); nbcdEff and eccdEff are not used. |
| `profiles.nbcdEff` | number | — | `0.25` | [0, 10] | Neutral-beam current-drive efficiency factor. |
| `profiles.eccdEff` | number | — | `0` | [0, 10] | Electron-cyclotron current-drive efficiency factor. |
| `profiles.eccd` | object | — | — | — | *Used only while `profiles.cdModel` is on.* ECCD launcher of cdModel 'physics': harmonic, frequency, parallel index, poloidal angle of the absorption, aim and width of the layer. |

##### Sawteeth

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.sawtoothTrigger` | string | — | `"shear"` | `"shear"`, `"porcelli"` | **Opt-in module: Sawtooth trigger.** Default `"shear"` (off). Sawtooth trigger. 'shear': s1 &gt; sawtoothShear at q = 1. 'porcelli': the three conditions of Porcelli, Boucher and Rosenbluth (1996), equations 13-15 (ideal, trapped-ion and fast-ion energy of the internal kink, diamagnetic stabilisation, growth rate of the ion-kinetic layer). |
| `profiles.sawtoothShear` | number | — | `0.2` | (0, 10] | Shear s1 at q = 1 that triggers a sawtooth crash. |
| `profiles.sawtoothReconnection` | string | — | `"legacy"` | `"legacy"`, `"kadomtsev"` | **Opt-in module: Sawtooth reconnection.** Default `"legacy"` (off). Sawtooth reconnection. 'legacy': T_e, T_i, n_e flattened inside the mixing radius, q raised to 1.01 there. 'kadomtsev': the same mixing with the poloidal flux reset of Kadomtsev's full reconnection (helical flux conserved). |

##### Boundary and edge

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.edgeModel` | string | — | `"legacy"` | `"legacy"`, `"twoPoint"` | **Opt-in module: Edge model for the separatrix temperature.** Default `"legacy"` (off). Separatrix temperature of the 1.5D boundary. 'legacy': conduction-limited two-point T_sep (outboard share 0.6, clamped to 0.03-0.5 keV); 'twoPoint': T_sep of the edge model (Eich lambda_q, divertor spreading, outer-leg power share), guard band 5 eV - 2 keV. The edge diagnostics use the edge model either way. |
| `profiles.Tsep_keV` | number | keV | — | (0, 10] | Fixed separatrix temperature; the two-point model if absent. |
| `profiles.nsepFrac` | number | — | `0.35` | (0, 1] | Separatrix density over the volume-averaged electron density. |

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.neoclassicalModel` | string | — | `"sauter"` | `"sauter"`, `"redl"` | **Opt-in module: Neoclassical coefficients.** Default `"sauter"` (off). Coefficients of the bootstrap current and of the neoclassical conductivity. 'sauter': Sauter, Angioni and Lin-Liu (1999, with the 2002 correction); 'redl': Redl et al. (2021), the same structure refitted to the numerical code NEO (less bootstrap current in the collisional edge and with impurities). |

###### `profiles.lcfsRef95`

The 95 % surface shape (kappa95, delta95) that lcfsKappa and lcfsDelta belong to. The 0D volume, surface and cross-section then follow an edited `geometry.kappa` or `geometry.delta` in the ratio kappa/kappa95 and delta/delta95 (the ITER and DEMO presets); without it the LCFS values are absolute.

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.lcfsRef95.kappa` | number, required | — | — | [1, 5] | Elongation of the 95 % surface that lcfsKappa belongs to. |
| `profiles.lcfsRef95.delta` | number, required | — | — | [-1, 1] | Triangularity of the 95 % surface that lcfsDelta belongs to. |

###### `profiles.eccd`

ECCD launcher of cdModel 'physics': harmonic, frequency, parallel index, poloidal angle of the absorption, aim and width of the layer.

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles.eccd.harmonic` | integer | — | `2` | [1, 3] | Cyclotron harmonic of the absorption, 1 to 3 (default 2). |
| `profiles.eccd.freq_GHz` | number | GHz | — | (0, 1000] | Wave frequency; if absent the frequency is the one whose Doppler-shifted resonance is at the aim. |
| `profiles.eccd.nPar` | number | — | `0.3` | [-0.99, 0.99] | Parallel refractive index; positive drives current along the plasma current, negative against it (default 0.3). |
| `profiles.eccd.thetaP_deg` | number | deg | `0` | [-180, 180] | Poloidal angle of the absorption on the flux surface: 0 outboard midplane, 180 inboard. |
| `profiles.eccd.rho` | number | rho_tor | — | [0, 1) | Aim: normalised radius of the deposition layer (default ecrhRho). |
| `profiles.eccd.width` | number | rho_tor | — | (0, 1] | Width of the deposition layer (default ecrhWidth). |

A property of the machine, not of the simulated shot (default 1055 s, the PROCESS default plasma pulse). |
| `systems.tf` | object | — | — | — | TF coil (winding pack and case) inputs. |
| `systems.cs` | object | — | — | — | Central-solenoid flux budget. Giving this block turns the flux check on: a warning if the solenoid cannot supply the pulse. |

## Scenario

Waveforms of the actuator controls and triggers on the frame diagnostics that drive one shot (`new Simulation(cfg, { scenario })`, `--scenario FILE` of the command line tools, the scenario editor of the app). Generated from src/cli/scenarioSchema.ts (npm run schema:scenario); do not edit.

### Top-level fields

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | constant, required | — | — | `1` | version of the JSON form |
| `name` | string | — | — | 0 to 120 characters | free label (not part of the fingerprint of a run) |
| `rampStep` | number | — | — | ≥ 0.000001 | upper bound of the time between step boundaries on a ramping segment of a pwl waveform (default: none); at least 0.000001, and at least t_end / 10000 for the shot it is used with |
| `waveforms` | object | — | — | — | waveform of a control, by the key of the control (the keys the model exposes; the known ones are listed here with their limits) |
| `triggers` | array of object | — | — | 0 to 128 items | — |

Rules the JSON Schema cannot express (the loader enforces them):

- `step-distinct-times`: the points of a step waveform have distinct times (points are sorted by time by the loader)
- `known-keys`: a waveform, a patch and a trigger name only controls and diagnostics that the model of the run exposes
- `ramp-grid`: rampStep is at least t_end / 10000 of the shot it is used with

### Controls with a documented limit

The keys of `waveforms`, of `triggers[].set` and of `triggers[].release` that the model exposes as actuator controls.
Other keys are accepted if the model of the run exposes them (rule `known-keys`).

| Key | Control | Unit | Value limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `P_NBI_MW` | NBI power | MW | ≥ 0 |
| `P_ICRH_MW` | ICRH power | MW | ≥ 0 |
| `P_ECRH_MW` | ECRH power | MW | ≥ 0 |
| `P_aux_MW` | auxiliary power | MW | ≥ 0 |
| `n_target_1e20` | density target (volume average) | 1e20 m⁻³ | ≥ 0 |
| `H98` | confinement multiplier H98 | — | ≥ 0 |
| `H_ISS04` | confinement multiplier H_ISS04 | — | ≥ 0 |
| `cZ` | impurity concentration | — | ≥ 0 |
| `fuelRate_1e20s` | fuelling rate limit | 1e20 s⁻¹ | ≥ 0 |
| `kappa_conf` | confinement factor | — | ≥ 0 |
| `muonRate_per_s` | muon rate | s⁻¹ | ≥ 0 |
| `Ip_MA` | plasma current | MA | ≥ 0 |

### `waveforms.<control>`: a waveform

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `waveforms.<control>.kind` | enum, required | — | — | `"pwl"`, `"step"` | 'pwl': piecewise linear between the points, constant after the last; 'step': holds each value from its time on |
| `waveforms.<control>.points` | array of [number, number or null], required | — | — | elements ≥ 0, any; 1 to 4096 items | — |

### `triggers[]`: a trigger on a frame diagnostic

| Field | Type | Unit | Default | Allowed values / range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `triggers[].id` | string | — | — | 1 to 64 characters; pattern `^[^\u0000-\u001f]+$` | label for the event log (default: "&lt;diag&gt; &lt;op&gt; &lt;value&gt;") |
| `triggers[].diag` | string, required | — | — | pattern `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$` | key of the frame diagnostics (Q, H_mode, betaN, nG_frac, ...) |
| `triggers[].op` | enum, required | — | — | `">"`, `">="`, `"<"`, `"<="` | — |
| `triggers[].value` | number, required | — | — | — | — |
| `triggers[].hold` | number | — | — | ≥ 0 | dwell time (default 0): the condition must have held on consecutive frames for this long |
| `triggers[].after` | number | — | — | ≥ 0 | earliest firing time (default 0), independent of hold |
| `triggers[].set` | object, required | — | — | — | control values written when the trigger fires |
| `triggers[].mode` | enum | — | — | `"once"`, `"repeat"` | 'once' (default) or 'repeat' |
| `triggers[].hysteresis` | number | — | — | ≥ 0 | repeat only: how far the diagnostic must cross back over value before the trigger re-arms (default 0) |
| `triggers[].release` | object | — | — | — | repeat only: control values written when the trigger re-arms |
